as_told.title: Fitts: missing Pentagon money funds the breakaway civilization

plain: Trillions of dollars have gone missing from the Pentagon's budget to pay for secret projects, according to a former federal official named Catherine Austin Fitts, as others retell her. Michels mentions her in passing, saying the money goes 'towards these projects'. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb puts the figure at 17 to 21 trillion dollars hidden in the US black budget, the secret part of defense spending, since the 1990s alone. A UFO historian named Richard Dolan says Fitts told him his idea of a 'breakaway civilization', a secret group with advanced technology that has split off from the rest of society, is 'right on'.
